curriculum.title: Nested collections and tuples
curriculum.answer:
## Nested collections and tuples

A nested collection is a collection stored inside another collection. The inner value can be a list, a dictionary, or a tuple, and you reach it by reading the outer container first, then the inner one.

### 1. List of dictionaries

Many programs keep rows of similar data as a list where every position holds a dictionary:

```python
students = [{"name": "Hermione", "house": "Gryffindor"}, {"name": "Draco", "house": "Slytherin"}]
result = students[1]["house"]
print(result)
```

```text
Slytherin
```

`students[1]` selects the second dictionary. Adding `["house"]` then selects the value inside that dictionary. The order matters: list position first, dictionary key second.

### 2. Tuples and tuples inside containers

A tuple groups values with commas and is read with positions starting at zero. Tuples can also be nested or stored inside lists and dictionaries:

```python
pair = (5, 9)
first = pair[0]
info = {"name": "Bo", "tags": ("red", "blue")}
colour = info["tags"][1]
print(first)
print(colour)
print(pair)
```

```text
5
blue
(5, 9)
```

Here `pair[0]` is `5`. For `info`, `info["tags"]` is the tuple `("red", "blue")`, so `info["tags"][1]` is `"blue"`. Parentheses show a tuple on output.

A common mistake is swapping the steps, writing `record["name"][0]` when `record` is a list. A list needs a numeric position first. Another mistake is using position `1` for the first item; position `0` is first, position `1` is second. 

A tuple position cannot be reassigned after the tuple is created. A list position can be reassigned. Reading a position does not change either collection.

exercise.title: Second house lookup
exercise.instructions: class_list is a list with exactly two dictionaries. Each dictionary has keys "name" and "house". Assign to result the "house" value from the second dictionary in class_list. For example, if class_list were [{"name": "Bo", "house": "Red"}, {"name": "Al", "house": "Blue"}], result would become "Blue". Do not change class_list.
